title: 2026年第二季度雅思口语机经
source: 新东方在线雅思研发中心 · 纯题目版

questions: Do you work or are you a student?
What subject are you studying?
Why did you choose that subject?
What would you like to do in the future?
What are the most popular subjects in China?
Do you think it's important to choose a subject you like?
Are you looking forward to working?
Do you like your subject? (Why? / Why not?)
Do you prefer to study in the mornings or in the afternoons?
Is your subject interesting to you?
Is there any kind of technology you can use in study?
What kind of learning method helps you?
How many hours a week do you study for?
Is there any difference between the study life of you and your parents?
Where is your school?
Do you like your school?
Is there anything you want to change about your school?
Do you think your school is a good place to study?
What is the environment like at your school?
How important is interest in study?
Which subject do you find challenging?
What work do you do?
Why did you choose to do that type of job?
Do you like your job?
Do you miss being a student?
Is it very interesting?
Is there any kind of technology you use at work?
Can you manage your time well when you work?
Who helps you most at work?
How many hours a week do you work for?
Do you currently have a good work environment?
What do you think could be improved at your workplace?
Have you ever thought about changing jobs?
What do you think would be challenging when you start working in the future?
Is there a place in your company that makes you feel relaxed?
What are the advantages of a company having a relaxation room?
Has your hometown changed much these years?
Is that a big city or a small place?
How long have you been living here?
For you, what benefits are there living in a big city?
Is there anything you dislike about it?
What do you like most about your hometown?
Where in your country do you live?
Are the transport facilities in your city very good?
Which room does your family spend most of the time in?
Do you live in a house or a flat?
Do you plan to live here for a long time?
Do you live alone or with your family?
How long have you lived there?
What do you usually do in your house/flat/room?
Which is your favourite room in your home?
What's the difference between where you are living now and where you lived in the past? (If you want to say you have not lived elsewhere)
What can you see when you look out the window of your room?
Would you be willing to live in the countryside in the future?
Do you like the area that you live in now?
Do you think the area you live in now is suitable for people of all ages?
Are people in your area friendly?
How has your area changed in recent years?
Do you know any famous people in your area?
Where do you like to go in your area?
Did you like going to parks as a child?
Do you still like going to parks now?
Would you like to see more parks in your city?
Are there any parks you want to go to in the future?
Would you prefer to play in a personal garden or public garden?
How are the parks today different from those you visited as a kid?
What do you like to do when visiting a park?
Did you enjoy traveling by car when you were a kid?
What types of cars do you like?
Do you prefer to be a driver or a passenger?
What do you usually do when there is a traffic jam?
Do you think car colours are important?
Will you buy an expensive car in the future?
Do you like shopping?
How often do you go shopping?
Do you prefer online shopping or in-store shopping?
Have you ever returned anything you bought online?
Do you wear a watch?
Have you ever got a watch as a gift?
Why do some people wear expensive watches?
Do you think it is important to wear a watch? Why?
What kinds of websites do you usually use?
What is your favorite website?
Are there any changes about the websites you usually use?
What kinds of websites are popular in your country?
Do you like to keep things tidy?
Did you use to keep your room tidy as a child?
How do you keep your work or study space tidy?
Do you think that it is necessary to be tidy?
Do you like looking at yourself in the mirror?
Have you ever bought mirrors?
Do you usually take a mirror with you?
Would you use mirrors to decorate your room?
Do you remember your teachers from primary school?
Do you have a favorite teacher?
Did you want to be a teacher when you were young?
What kinds of teacher do you prefer?
Are you still in touch with your primary school teachers?
In what way has your favourite teacher helped you?
Have you ever posted anything on social media?
When did you start to use social media?
Do you think you spend too much time on social media?
Do your friends use social media?
What do people do on social media?
What was your dream when you were a child?
Are you the kind of person who never gives up on dreams?
What is your main ambition in life now?
Do you think you are an ambitious person?
Do you prefer sad or happy music?
Does happy music make you feel more excited?
Do you like science?
When did you start to learn about science?
Which science subject is interesting to you?
What kinds of interesting things have you done with science?
Do you like watching science TV programs?
Do Chinese people often visit science museums?
Do you like singing?
Have you ever learnt how to sing?
If you sing, who would you sing in front of?
Do you think singing can bring happiness to people?
Have you ever learnt about outer space and stars?
Do you like science fiction movies? Why?
Do you want to know more about outer space?
Do you want to go into outer space in the future?
What kind of clothes do you often wear in daily life?
Is there any difference between the clothes you wear on weekends and weekdays?
Is there any color you dislike when buying clothes?
Do you like wearing T-shirts?
Do you spend a lot of time choosing clothes?
Do you use headphones?
When do you use headphones?
What type of headphones do you use?
In what occasions will you not use headphones?
Are you good at telling jokes?
Do your friends like to tell jokes?
Do you like to watch comedies?
Have you ever watched a live show?
Have you ever seen some old buildings in your city?
Do you think we should keep old buildings in cities?
Would you prefer living in an old building or a modern house?
Have you ever been to historical museums?
Do you like history?
When was the last time you read about history?
Did you like history when you were young?
Did you often go to the cinema when you were a child?
Do you often go to the cinema with your friends?
Do you still like the same kind of movie which you liked when you were a child?
What genres of films do you like?
Do you think going to the cinema is a good way to spend time with friends?
Do you like morning or evening?
What do you usually do in the evening?
Are there any differences between what you do in the evening now and what you did in the past?
Did you have any pets when you were a child?
Do you like to see animals in the zoo?
What's your favorite animal?
What is the most popular animal in China?
Where do you prefer to keep your pet, indoors or outdoors?
Do you usually spend your day off with parents or friends?
What do you often do on your days off?
When was the last time you had a few days off?
What would you like to do if you had a day off tomorrow?
Do you often remember your dreams?
Are you interested in others' dreams?
Do you want to make your dreams come true?
Do you always bring a lot of keys with you?
Have you ever lost your keys?
How can we avoid losing keys?
Do you walk a lot?
Did you often go outside to have a walk when you were a child?
Why do people like to walk in parks?
Where would you like to take a long walk if you had the chance?
Where did you go for a walk lately?
What kinds of gifts do you usually like receiving?
Are you good at choosing gifts?
Have you ever given a person a gift you made yourself?
What do you consider when choosing a gift?
What is your morning routine?
Do you like to get up early in the mornings?
What do you usually eat for breakfast?
Do you think breakfast is important?
Are there any differences between the mornings of your childhood and now?
Would you like to change your morning routine?
Do you like reading?
Do you prefer to read on paper or on a screen?
When do you need to read carefully, and when not?
Do you have any hobbies?
Did you have any hobbies when you were a child?
Do you have the same hobbies as your family members?
Do you type on a desktop or laptop keyboard every day?
When did you learn how to type on a keyboard?
How do you improve your typing?
What is your favourite food?
What kind of food did you like when you were young?
Do you eat different foods at different times of the year?
Do you look out the window at the scenery when travelling by bus or car?
Do you take photos of the scenery outside the car window?
Do you prefer the mountains or the sea?
What are the most beautiful sights you have seen while travelling?
Do you prefer views in urban areas or rural areas?
Do you prefer views in your own country or in other countries?
Do you take photos of buildings?
Is there a building that you would like to visit?
Are there tall buildings near your home?
What were your favourite activities when you were a child?
Did you prefer to do activities alone or with a group of people when you were a child?
Do you think children today play the same games as you did when you were a child?
Have you ever been part of a sports team?
Are team-sports popular in your culture?
Do you like watching team games? Why?
What are the differences between team sports and individual sports?

part2.title: Describe a person who has chosen a career in the medical field (e.g. a doctor, a nurse).
bullets: And explain how you feel about him/her
part3: Do you think doctors and nurses are very important?
Who is more important, doctors or nurses?
Do you think that doctors and nurses are not paid enough?
Do you think it is necessary to learn first aid skills?

part2.title: Describe your favorite childhood friend.
bullets: And explain what made you like him/her
part3: Why do people lose contact with their friends after graduation?
How does modern technology influence friendship?
Do you think people's relationship with friends will change when they get older?

part2.title: Describe a person you know who loves to grow plants (e.g. vegetables/fruits/ flowers etc.).
bullets: And explain why he/she enjoys this activity
part3: What are the advantages of growing vegetables or flowers at home?
Do many people grow vegetables or flowers at home in your country?
Is it easy to grow plants at home?
Why do some people prefer to grow their own fruits and vegetables instead of buying them from the market?

part2.title: Describe a successful business person you admire.
bullets: What kind of business this person does
And explain why you admire this person
part3: What do you think is the retirement age for men and women?
What kinds of qualities should a successful businessman have?
What are important factors in making a company successful?
If you had the opportunity to run your own business, what business would it be? Why?

part2.title: Describe a person who is good at learning and speaking new languages.
bullets: How you got to know him/her
How he/she learns a new language
And explain how you feel about him/her
part3: Are there many people who can speak foreign languages in your country?
Does speaking other languages help at work?
Do people learn any languages other than English?
Why is it easier for children to learn new things than for adults?
How do people learn new things?

part2.title: Describe a famous person you would like to meet.
bullets: How/where you would like to meet him/her
And explain why you would like to meet him/her
part3: What are the advantages and disadvantages of being a famous child?
What can today's children do to become famous?
What can children do with their fame?
Do people become famous because of their talent?

part2.title: Describe a child you know who likes drawing very much.
bullets: And explain why you think he/she likes drawing
part3: What is the right age for a child to learn drawing?
Why do most children draw more often than adults do?
Why do some people visit galleries or museums instead of viewing artworks online?
Do you think galleries and museums should be free of charge?
How do artworks inspire people?

part2.title: Describe a person who makes plans a lot.
bullets: And explain how you feel about this person
part3: Do you think it's important to plan ahead?
Do you think children should plan their future careers?
Should children ask their teachers or parents for advice when making plans?

part2.title: Describe a person who encouraged you to protect the nature.
bullets: What he/she encouraged you to do
And explain how you feel about this person
part3: How can parents teach their children to protect nature?
Should schools teach children to get close to nature?
Do you think there should be laws to protect nature?

part2.title: Describe a person who gave a clever solution to a problem.
bullets: And explain why you think it was a clever solution
part3: Do you think children are born with certain degree of cleverness? Or their intelligence can be nurtured?
What can schools do to students' intellectual development?
Why do you think some people are really good at something?
Why are different kinds of intelligence needed in this modern society?

part2.title: Describe one of your friends who learned a skill from someone (not a teacher).
bullets: And explain whether it would be easier to learn from a teacher
part3: Is it necessary to keep learning after graduating from school?
Should teachers make learning in their classes fun?
Do you think there are too many subjects for students to learn?
Is it better to focus on a few subjects or to learn many subjects?
Do you think enterprises should provide training for their employees?
Do you think it is good for older adults to continue learning?

part2.title: Describe someone living in your area who often helps others.
bullets: And explain why he/she often helps others
part3: Should children help their parents with household chores?
What kind of help do people need when looking for a new job?
Who should people ask for help, colleagues or family members?

part2.title: Describe a kind of food people eat during the special event.
bullets: What event people usually eat it
And explain why it is for the special event.
part3: Why do some people grow their own food these days?
Is there any traditional food in your country?
What can be the reasons that some young people prefer foreign food to traditional food?
Which food is generally popular in your country?
Will there be more and more people planting food in the future?
What are the differences between everyday food and festival food?
Are there any differences between the food people eat today and the food people ate in the past?

part2.title: Describe something you cannot live without (not a computer/ phone).
bullets: How it helps you in your life
And explain why you cannot live without it
part3: Why are children attracted to electronic devices?
Why do some adults hate to throw away old things, such as clothes?
What do you think influences people to buy new things?

part2.title: Describe a piece of technology (not a phone) that you would like to own.
bullets: What you will use it for
And explain why you would like to own it
part3: What are the differences between the technology of the past and that of today?
What technology do young people like to use?
What are the differences between online and face-to-face communication?

part2.title: Describe an item on which you spent more than expected.
bullets: How much you spent on it
And explain why you think you spent more than expected
part3: Do you often pay more than you expected?
What do you think young people spend most of their money on?
Do you think it is important to save money?

part2.title: Describe a new law you would like to introduce in your country.
bullets: Whether this new law will be popular
And explain how you feel about this
part3: What rules should students follow at school?
Do people often violate rules or laws in China?
What kinds of behavior are considered as good behavior?
Do you think children can learn about the law outside of school?
What are the benefits for people to obey rules?
How can parents teach children to obey rules?

part2.title: Describe an interesting video.
bullets: When and where you watched it
And explain how you feel about it
part3: What kind of videos do people in your country like to watch?
Which is more helpful, watching videos or reading books?
What skills can people learn from watching videos?
Are there any differences between the videos that young people and old people like to watch?

part2.title: Describe an advertisement with a famous person in it.
bullets: And explain how you feel about the advertisement
part3: What are the advantages and disadvantages of advertisements?
Why are many advertisements endorsed by celebrities? How useful are they?
What is the most important factor in an advertisement?
Why are some advertisements boring?
Is advertising important for a company? Why?
Which is more effective, online advertising or offline advertising?

part2.title: Describe a TV show/online program you have watched recently.
bullets: And explain how you feel about it
part3: What are the differences between the TV programs young people like to watch and those old people like to watch?
What makes a popular TV or online program?
What kinds of TV or online programs are popular in your country?

part2.title: Describe a story/book with animals in it.
bullets: And explain what you think of this story/book
part3: Should schools teach children about animals?
Some people think pets should not be kept in cities. What do you think?
Many people regard pets as members of their family. What do you think?
Do many people keep pets in your country?
What are the advantages of keeping a pet?
Why do people always tell children stories with animals?

part2.title: Describe something that helped you learn a foreign language.
bullets: Why you chose to learn that language
And explain how this thing helped you
part3: What difficulties do people face when learning a language?
Do you think language learning is important?
Is studying abroad a good way to learn a foreign language?

part2.title: Describe a law or regulation about environmental protection.
bullets: How you first learned about it
And explain how you feel about this law or regulation
part3: What kind of rules do schools in China have?
What should teachers do to make students obey rules?
Are there any laws about education in China?
What are the rules people should obey at work?
What is the purpose of punishment?

part2.title: Describe an ambition that you have had for a long time.
bullets: What you can do for it
And explain why you have this as an ambition
part3: What kinds of ambitions do people have?
Why should parents encourage children to have ambitions?
Should parents interfere with their children’s ambitions?

part2.title: Describe a perfect job you want to do in the future.
bullets: How you can find this job
What you need to prepare for this job
And explain why you want to do this job
part3: What kinds of jobs do children want to do?
What kind of professions are popular in your country?
Why do some people change their ideal jobs from time to time?
What should people consider when choosing jobs?
Is salary the main reason people choose a certain job?

part2.title: Describe a program or app on your computer or phone.
bullets: And explain how you feel about it
part3: What are the differences between old and young people when using apps?
Why do some people not like using apps?
What apps are popular in your country? Why?
Should parents limit their children using computer programs and computer games?
Do you think young people rely more and more on these programs?

part2.title: Describe a movie you watched recently.
bullets: When and where you watched it
And explain why you chose to watch this movie
part3: What kinds of movies do you think are successful in your country?
What are the factors that make a successful movie?
Do Chinese people prefer to watch domestic movies or foreign movies?
Do you think only well-known directors can create the best movies?
Do you think successful movies should have well-known actors or actresses in leading roles?
Why do people prefer to watch movies in the cinema?

part2.title: Describe your favorite city that you have visited.
bullets: And explain why it is your favourite city
part3: Which is more suitable for young people, urban life or rural life, and which is more suitable for old people?
How do people choose a city to travel to?
Do you think a tourist city is also a good place to live? Why?
Do most people prefer to travel in a modern city or a historical city?

part2.title: Describe a boring place.
bullets: And explain why you think it is a boring place
part3: Why do most children think education is boring?
Why aren't young people willing to listen to the experiences of older people?
What can people do when they feel bored?

part2.title: Describe a tall building in your city you like or dislike.
bullets: And explain why you like or dislike it
part3: What are the advantages of living in a tall building?
Do you think there will be more tall buildings in the future?
Why aren't there many tall buildings in the countryside?

part2.title: Describe a place you would like to visit in your free time.
bullets: How long you will stay there
And explain why you would like to visit it
part3: Why do you think some people choose not to travel abroad?
Do you think a gap period in life is important?

part2.title: Describe a place in your country that you would like to recommend to travelers.
bullets: And explain why you would like to recommend it to travelers
part3: Where do people in your country often go for holidays?
Where do young people in your country often go for holidays?
What is the ideal length for a holiday?
How do people usually plan holidays?
Is it important to plan a holiday ahead?

part2.title: Describe a friend's home you visited but you don't want to live there.
bullets: What kind of home it is
And explain why you don't want to live there
part3: Do Chinese people like to visit others' homes?
What do Chinese people do when they visit others?
What kind of place do people in your country like to live in?
What's the difference between homes in cities and those in the countryside?

part2.title: Describe an important river/lake in your country.
bullets: And explain why it is important
part3: How can rivers/lakes benefit local people?
How do rivers/lakes affect local tourism?
Are rivers/lakes useful for transport?

part2.title: Describe your favourite place in your home where you can relax.
bullets: And explain why you feel relaxed at this place
part3: Why is it difficult for someone to relax?
Do people in your country exercise after work?
What is the place where people spend most of their time in their home?
Do you think there should be classes for training young people and children to relax?
Which is more important, mental relaxation or physical relaxation?

part2.title: Describe a shopping mall.
bullets: And what you usually buy at the mall
part3: Why do people like shopping?
Do you think spending money makes people happy?
Why do people buy things they don't need?

part2.title: Describe a time when you got up early.
bullets: And explain how you felt about it
part3: Why do some people like to get up early?
Why do people get up early?
What kinds of occasions need people to arrive early?
Why do some people like to stay up late?
Is it good to arrive early in any situation?

part2.title: Describe a time when you worked in a group.
bullets: And explain why you worked in the group
part3: Why do some people prefer to work by themselves?
What should a leader do to make team members want to follow him or her?
Should students learn to do group work?
What group tasks are there in schools?

part2.title: Describe a plan that you had to change recently.
bullets: What made you change the plan
And how you felt about the change
part3: Do people often change their plans?
Would you tell others if you change your plan?
Why do you think parents still make plans for their children nowadays?
How does technology help people make plans?

part2.title: Describe an important decision you made in life.
bullets: And explain why this decision was important
part3: What important decisions do young people need to make after graduation?
Who can children turn to for help when making decisions?
Do you think children sometimes have to make important decisions?
Do you think advertisements influence our decisions on shopping?
What are the benefits of advertising?
How do people usually make important decisions?

part2.title: Describe a live sports event you watched before.
bullets: And explain how you felt about this experience
part3: Why do some people like to watch sports events?
Where do people normally watch sports events?
What are the advantages of watching sports events online?
What sports matches are suitable for children to attend?

part2.title: Describe an occasion you had a special cake.
bullets: And explain why it was a special cake
part3: What's the difference between special food in China and foreign countries?
Do Chinese people usually cook special food in traditional festivals?
Do Chinese families like to eat together during traditional holidays?
Why do people spend more on special food on special occasions?

part2.title: Describe a challenging technological problem you faced.
bullets: When and where you faced it
And explain how you solved it
part3: What are the advantages and disadvantages of AI?
Do you think people today should learn about AI technology?
Should children learn to use AI?
How can AI help in our lives?
Do you think students are overly reliant on AI?
What can teachers do to stop students relying too much on AI?

part2.title: Describe a time when you had a problem with using an electronic device.
bullets: And explain how you solved the problem at last
part3: Why are people keen on buying new electronic devices?
What impact do electronic devices have on people?

part2.title: Describe a special day out that didn't cost you much.
bullets: And explain how you feel about that day
part3: How do people spend their leisure time in China?
How does technology affect the way people spend their leisure time?
Do you think only old people have time for leisure?

part2.title: Describe a time when you received a message or email and it took you a long time to reply.
bullets: Why you spent a lot of time replying
And explain how you felt about the experience
part3: When do people spend a long time responding to others' messages?
In what situations do people not respond to messages right away?
What would you do if you haven't received a reply after sending out a message?

part2.title: Describe a time when you felt proud of a family member.
bullets: And explain why you felt proud of him/her
part3: What would children do to make their parents proud?
What did you do to make your parents proud when you were young?
What advantages of yours make you proud?
When was the last time that you felt proud of yourself?

part2.title: Describe an occasion when you were not allowed to use a mobile phone.
bullets: Why you were not allowed to use it
And explain how you felt about that
part3: How do young and old people use mobile phones differently?
What positive and negative impact do mobile phones have on friendship?
Is it a waste of time to take pictures with mobile phones?
Do you think it is necessary to have laws on the use of mobile phones?

part2.title: Describe an occasion when many people were smiling.
bullets: And explain why many people were smiling
part3: Do you think people who like to smile are friendlier?
Why do most people smile in photographs?
Do people smile more when they are younger or older?

part2.title: Describe a time when you gave advice to others.
bullets: To whom you gave the advice
And explain why you gave the advice
part3: Should people prepare before giving advice?
Is it good to ask advice from strangers online?
What are the personalities of people whose job is to give advice to others?
What are the problems if you ask too many people for advice?

part2.title: Describe a bicycle/motorcycle/car trip you would like to go on.
bullets: Who you would like to go with
Where you would like to go
When you would like to go
And explain why you would like to go by bicycle/motorcycle/car
part3: Which form of vehicle is the most popular in your country? Bikes, cars or motorcycles?
Do you think air pollution comes mostly from mobile vehicles?
Do you think people need to change the way of transportation fundamentally to protect the environment?
How are the transportation systems in urban areas and rural areas different?

part2.title: Describe a music event that you didn't enjoy.
bullets: Why you decided to go there
And explain why you didn't enjoy it
part3: What kind of music events do people like today?
Do you think music education is important?
What's the difference between the music that young people like and the music that old people like?

part2.title: Describe a time when you used imagination.
bullets: Why you need to use imagination
And explain how you felt about this experience
part3: Do you think adults can have lots of imagination?
Do you think imagination is essential for scientists?
What kinds of jobs need imagination?
What subjects are helpful for children's imagination?

part2.title: Describe a time when you encouraged someone to do something that he/she didn't want to do.
bullets: What you encouraged him/her to do
And explain why you encouraged him/her to do it
part3: How can leaders encourage workers to work hard?
Do you think some people are better than others at persuading?
When should parents encourage their children?
